intro: Our Uno study table gives your ideas room to grow with a spacious surface and smart storage—keeping books, gadgets, and inspiration within reach, so focus comes naturally.

features.title: Spacious top for work, meals, or hobbies
features.text: Stay focused and productive—ours pacious desk gives you plenty of room to work, study, or create, helping you tackle tasks without feeling cramped.

features.title: Smooth drawers save you time and effort
features.text: Open drawers effortlessly—this channeled system ensures smooth, quiet operation, making organisation a breeze.

features.title: Compact design that fits anywhere
features.text: Designed for versatility, its space-saving form slips effortlessly into any room—giving you a functional workspace or display area without compromising on style or comfort.

features.title: Roomy leg space for added comfort
features.text: With generous legroom beneath the table, you can stretch out comfortably while working, dining, or simply unwinding.

features.title: Keeps wires organised and clutter-free
features.text: Messy cables have no place in your home. Our thoughtfully crafted design conceals wires effortlessly, helping you maintain a clean, clutter-free space with zero hassle.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
